headline: Industrial Innovation Act amendments completed; experts: will help retain talent and new startup development | Industry & Economy
summary: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passed amendments to the Industrial Innovation Act, raising the cap on tax deferral for employee compensation stock. Experts said the changes will help retain talent.
why: The Industrial Innovation Act governs tax incentives and recognition rules for startups and innovative businesses in Taiwan.
